estimand: Incremental city-transfer predictive information in independent surveyed buildings after the February 2023 sequence, conditional on retrospective structural-design proxies; not population vulnerability or prospective operational prediction.

target.duplicate_coordinate_conflicts: quarantine all records at conflicting coordinates

additional_sensitivity: H versus H+Z_GeoAI on the same frozen cohort, omitting retrospective survey X
prohibited: workbook IMs with unresolved product revision

chronology.X: post-event ascertainment of presumed pre-existing structural family; height brackets removed; not independently verified pre-event
chronology.DSM: Copernicus GLO30 AWS 2021 release, main acquisition 2011-2015
chronology.H: fixed reconstructed 2025 mainshock ShakeMap, allowed retrospective hazard exception

comparison: Identical eligible rows, city folds and inverse coordinate-multiplicity weights for all arms. GeoAI replaces engineered Z in the primary comparison; additive union requires a separately declared sensitivity.

metrics.primary: normalized ranked probability score: mean squared cumulative-probability error at thresholds 0..3
metrics.aggregation: unweighted mean of nonempty test-city scores; list empty cities and supports, no substitution
secondary: macro F1 over fixed five classes
metrics.uncertainty: 2000 paired site bootstrap draws within test cities, seed 20231005; report city fold spread; conditional uncertainty, not independent-earthquake evidence

future_fit_protocol.learner: same regularized multinomial logistic readout in all arms; fixed five-class probability output; absent training classes receive zero probability and are reported
future_fit_protocol.selection: minimum validation RPS, ties smaller C; no test-city selection
future_fit_protocol.transforms: train-only standard scaling; fixed structural-family vocabulary with unseen values OTHER; no PCA, no feature selection, no encoder adaptation
future_fit_protocol.calibration: none in primary; do not fit on held-out cities
future_fit_protocol.site_weights: inverse exact-coordinate multiplicity for training, validation and scoring

encoder.name: SatMAE multispectral ViT-Large
encoder.pooling: mean of 432 final-normalized non-CLS tokens, identity no-mask path
encoder.status: design frozen; weights/inference not yet executed
